name: Maihara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Maihara city emblem in green and blue: a green and blue swirl of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Maihara, a city in Shiga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 14 February 2005.

features.role: Maihara city emblem — a green and blue swirl of curved strokes
